blocks.text: OrbitAvanya Tech LLP submits this response to Solicitation **1305M326Q0303** issued by the **U.S. Department of Labor, Employment Standards Administration, Wage and Hour Division** regarding **Wage Determination No. 2015-5153, Revision 30**. As a technology services firm specializing in enterprise software development, AI/ML systems, cloud-native architectures, and e-Governance digital transformation platforms, OrbitAvanya Tech LLP recognizes the critical importance of full compliance with all applicable wage determinations issued under the **Davis-Bacon Act**, **Service Contract Act (SCA)**, and related federal labor standards statutes. This wage determination establishes the minimum prevailing wage rates and fringe benefit requirements for service employees performing work on federal contracts in the specified locality. OrbitAvanya Tech LLP commits to full adherence to the wage rates, classifications, and fringe benefit provisions set forth in **Revision 30** of this determination for all covered employees engaged in any resulting contract performance. Our organization maintains robust payroll compliance systems, certified payroll reporting capabilities, and a demonstrated track record of compliance with **Department of Labor (DOL)** wage and hour requirements across federal engagements. This response outlines our compliance approach, monitoring mechanisms, and commitment to ensuring that all personnel — whether direct employees or subcontractor staff — receive wages and benefits at or above the rates prescribed in this determination.
Key Highlights

items: Full compliance commitment with **Wage Determination No. 2015-5153, Revision 30** for all covered service employee classifications
Established **certified payroll reporting** infrastructure aligned with **DOL WHD** requirements and **29 CFR Part 4** / **29 CFR Part 5** regulations
Automated wage compliance monitoring through integrated **HRIS/payroll platform** with real-time rate validation against current determinations

blocks.text: The **U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division (WHD)** issues wage determinations to establish minimum prevailing wage rates and fringe benefits for service employees working on federal contracts subject to the **Service Contract Act (41 U.S.C. § 6701 et seq.)** and the **Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. § 3141 et seq.)**. **Wage Determination No. 2015-5153, Revision 30** represents the current applicable determination for the specified geographic locality and contract type. As a prospective prime contractor to the **Employment Standards Administration**, OrbitAvanya Tech LLP recognizes that compliance with this determination is not merely a contractual obligation but a statutory mandate enforceable through **contract withholding**, **termination for default**, **debarment proceedings**, and **civil monetary penalties** under **29 CFR § 4.188** and **29 CFR § 5.12**. The revision history of this determination (30 revisions since 2015) underscores the dynamic nature of prevailing wage rates and the necessity for continuous monitoring. Our compliance strategy addresses the full lifecycle of wage determination adherence: initial classification mapping, ongoing rate currency verification, certified payroll submission, fringe benefit administration, subcontractor oversight, and audit readiness.
Finding 1 · Wage Determination Applicability and Coverage

Wage Determination **2015-5153, Revision 30** establishes minimum hourly wage rates and fringe benefit obligations for specific service employee classifications in the defined locality. The determination applies to all **covered service contracts** exceeding **$2,500** entered into by the federal government, including contracts for **IT services, professional services, administrative support, and facilities maintenance** — all categories relevant to OrbitAvanya's service portfolio. The determination specifies rates by **occupation code** aligned with the **Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) System** and **Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT)**.

items: Determination covers **service employee classifications** including **Computer Programmers (SOC 15-1251)**, **Systems Analysts (15-1211)**, **Database Administrators (15-1242)**, **Network Architects (15-1241)**, **Help Desk Technicians (15-1232)**, and **Administrative Support staff (43-9061)**
Fringe benefit rates specified for **health & welfare**, **pension/retirement**, **vacation**, **holiday**, and **sick leave** components
Geographic scope defined by **county/MSA** — applicable to all contract performance locations within the determination's locality
Revision 30 supersedes all prior revisions; effective date governs applicability to contract options and modifications

blocks.text: Finding 2 · Regulatory Compliance Framework

Compliance with this wage determination requires adherence to a multi-layered regulatory framework including the **Service Contract Labor Standards statute (formerly SCA)**, **Davis-Bacon Act** (for construction), **Executive Order 13658** (minimum wage for federal contractors), **Executive Order 14026** (**$17.20/hour** minimum wage effective **January 1, 2024**), **29 CFR Part 4** (labor standards for federal service contracts), **29 CFR Part 5** (Davis-Bacon regulations), and **29 CFR Part 1918** (enforcement). The **Wage and Hour Division** enforces through investigations, **compliance actions**, and referral for **debarment** under **FAR 9.4**.

items: **Executive Order 14026** minimum wage of **$17.20/hour** (2024) serves as floor where determination rate is lower
**29 CFR § 4.163** requires **certified payroll reports** (WH-347 or equivalent) submitted **weekly** to contracting officer
**29 CFR § 4.173** mandates **posting of wage determination** and **WHD poster (WH-1313)** at all worksites
**FAR 52.222-41** (Service Contract Labor Standards) and **FAR 52.222-6** (Davis-Bacon) contract clauses flow down to subcontractors
**FAR 52.222-55** requires **minimum wage compliance** under **EO 14026** for covered contracts

blocks.text: Finding 3 · Classification Risk and Mitigation

Misclassification of employees — particularly in **IT and professional services** where duties may span multiple SOC codes — represents the highest compliance risk. The **WHD** applies the **'primary duty' test** and **'actual duties performed'** standard, not job titles. OrbitAvanya's workforce includes personnel performing **hybrid roles** (e.g., DevOps engineers performing both development and system administration) requiring careful classification mapping to the determination's occupation codes.

items: **Primary duty analysis** for each employee mapped to determination occupation codes using **O*NET OnLine** and **SOC crosswalks
**Timekeeping granularity** at **15-minute intervals** with **task-level coding** to support classification defense
**Annual classification audits** by Labor Compliance Officer with **outside counsel review** for borderline roles
**Subcontractor classification verification** via **pre-award questionnaire** and **quarterly certification**

blocks.text: Finding 4 · Fringe Benefit Compliance Complexity

The determination specifies fringe benefit rates as **hourly cash equivalents** or **bona fide benefit plan contributions**. OrbitAvanya must ensure that **health insurance**, **401(k) matching**, **paid time off**, and **other benefits** meet or exceed the determination's fringe rate for each classification. The **'credit' mechanism** under **29 CFR § 4.171** allows offset of **bona fide plan costs** against the fringe obligation, but requires **plan documentation**, **ERISA compliance**, and **annual actuarial certification** for pension components.

items: **Health & welfare**: Employer-paid premium contributions for **medical, dental, vision, life, disability** validated against determination rate
**Pension/retirement**: **401(k) safe harbor match (4%)** plus **profit sharing** structured to meet or exceed determination pension rate
**Paid leave**: **PTO accrual rates** converted to hourly equivalent — **15 days PTO + 11 federal holidays = 4.61% fringe credit**
**Cash-in-lieu option**: Where benefit costs < determination fringe rate, **difference paid as taxable wages** per **29 CFR § 4.171(c)**

blocks.text: The scope of this compliance engagement encompasses the full range of wage determination adherence activities required for OrbitAvanya Tech LLP's performance as a prime contractor under any resulting contract incorporating **Wage Determination No. 2015-5153, Revision 30**. This includes: (1) **Workforce classification mapping** of all current and projected employees to determination occupation codes; (2) **Payroll system configuration** to apply correct wage rates and fringe credits by classification and location; (3) **Certified payroll reporting** generation and submission per **29 CFR § 4.163**; (4) **Fringe benefit plan administration** and cost allocation to meet determination requirements; (5) **Subcontractor compliance flow-down** and monitoring; (6) **Revision tracking** for future determination updates (Revision 31+); (7) **Audit readiness** documentation and **WHD investigation response** capability; and (8) **Executive Order 14026** minimum wage overlay compliance. The scope extends to all contract performance locations within the determination's geographic coverage and applies to all contract line items (CLINs) utilizing covered service employees.

blocks.text: OrbitAvanya Tech LLP's technical approach to wage determination compliance is built on a **three-pillar architecture**: **Automated Compliance Engine**, **Governance & Oversight Framework**, and **Audit-Ready Evidence Management**. The **Automated Compliance Engine** centers on our **HRIS/payroll platform (UKG Pro integrated with ADP)** configured with a **determination rate service** that ingests **WDOL.gov** and **SAM.gov** data feeds via **REST API** to maintain real-time rate currency. Each employee's **labor category assignment** drives automatic selection of the applicable occupation code rate, with **EO 14026 overlay logic** ensuring the statutory minimum wage floor is never breached. Fringe benefit compliance is managed through a **benefits cost allocation module** that calculates hourly employer costs for **health & welfare**, **pension**, and **paid leave** by classification, applying **29 CFR § 4.171** crediting rules and generating **cash-in-lieu payments** where plan costs fall below determination fringe rates. The **Governance & Oversight Framework** establishes a **Labor Compliance Officer (LCO)** role reporting to the **Chief Legal Officer**, supported by a **cross-functional compliance committee** (HR, Finance, Legal, Operations). The LCO conducts **monthly classification audits**, **quarterly fringe benefit reconciliations**, and **semi-annual subcontractor compliance reviews**. A **revision impact protocol** triggers within **24 hours** of Federal Register publication of a new determination revision, producing a **rate delta analysis**, **contract modification cost estimate**, and **contracting officer notification package** within **5 business days**. The **Audit-Ready Evidence Management** pillar leverages **AWS GovCloud** with **WORM-enabled S3 Object Lock** for immutable retention of all payroll records, timekeeping data, certified payroll submissions, fringe benefit calculations, and subcontractor certifications for **3 years post-contract completion** per **FAR 4.703**. A **compliance dashboard** provides the contracting officer real-time visibility into **certified payroll submission status**, **wage rate adherence metrics**, **fringe credit utilization rates**, and **open compliance issues**. This architecture ensures not only statutory compliance but also **operational efficiency**, **cost predictability**, and **defensibility** in the event of a **WHD investigation** or **GAO protest**.

OrbitAvanya Tech LLP proposes a **Fixed-Price with Economic Price Adjustment (FP-EPA)** pricing structure for wage determination compliance services, reflecting the **statutory pass-through nature** of wage and fringe benefit costs. The **compliance management fee** covers the **Labor Compliance Officer**, **automated platform licensing**, **audit readiness maintenance**, and **subcontractor oversight** — distinct from the **direct labor wage and fringe costs** which are reimbursed at actuals per the determination. The EPA clause addresses **determination revision rate changes** and **EO 14026 annual adjustments**. Pricing below reflects the **compliance management component only**; **direct labor costs** are bid separately per the **Labor Category Rate Matrix** in the cost volume.
